**Company Description**
-----------------------

**Sectigo** is the most innovative provider of certificate lifecycle management (CLM), delivering solutions that help the world’s largest brands simplify how digital trust is managed and scaled. Sectigo’s automated, cloud-native CLM platform issues and manages digital certificates across enterprise environments, enabling organizations to reduce complexity, accelerate time to value, and strengthen security across environments. Sectigo holds six combined active leadership seats in the CA/Browser Forum and ETSI and brings two decades of delivering unparalleled digital trust.  
  
**Simplicity at Scale.**  
  
How we show up with each other and our customers every day is just as important, and we win as #OneSectigo by living out our core values - Support, Excellence, Communication, Teamwork, Integrity, Growth and Openness. We are committed to investing in our diverse teams where everyone understands their role and how they support our strategic goals, we drive operational excellence through scale and efficiency, and we strive to delight our customers and become the market leader in our industry. If you aspire to join a driven team that holds each other accountable to meeting our lofty goals and you’d like to be part of our growth story in delivering a market leading user experience, we’d like to talk to you.

**Job Description**
-------------------

We are looking for a talented Senior Engineering Manager join our growing global team at Sectigo.

The Senior Engineering Manager will build and drive integration engineering capability from our India GCC. This team owns our engineering-led approach to third-party and platform integrations, starting with our ServiceNow implementation and a new pilot integrating PSA (Professional Services Automation) marketplace platforms into our core platform. This leader is genuinely AI-native by integrating AI tools daily in how we code, test, document, and make decisions.  
  
Here are the core functions, responsibilities, and expectations for this role:

  

* Define team structure and hiring plan for a new Integration Engineering org in Chennai.
* Own a blended workforce model: manage specialized consultants and a contracting team, with a contract-to-hire approach as the default and direct hiring for key roles where warranted.
* Recruit, onboard, and develop engineers; set the technical bar and team culture from day one. Own integration engineering delivery
* Take ownership of the ServiceNow workstream already underway, including a candid retrospective on what hasn't worked so far.
* Stand up the engineering model for the Pax8/ConnectWise marketplace/PSA integration pilot, in partnership with specialized consultants and the core platform team.
* Build this into a repeatable capability as the integration portfolio grows beyond these two initiatives. Define the operating model with core platform engineering
* Partner directly with the core platform engineering leadership to define architecture and integration patterns, required APIs/workflows, source-code access boundaries, development standards, and the technical point-of-contact model between teams.
* Push for a model where the core platform team focuses on the platform and exposes clean APIs/capabilities, while your team builds and owns integrations on top not one where core teams build every integration themselves. Lead as an AI-native engineering manager
* Use AI tools yourself, day to day for design exploration, code review, testing, documentation, and even parts of people/project management and set that as the visible norm for the team, not an optional add-on.
* Build documentation, API contracts, and integration patterns that are discoverable and usable by AI agents, not just humans.
* Create an engineering environment where AI increasingly assists with implementation, testing, validation, documentation, and knowledge transfer this is a core operating principle for the org from day one, not a future aspiration.
* Actively evaluate and introduce new AI-assisted engineering tools and workflows as they emerge, rather than waiting for direction from above. Operate as a proactive, senior engineering leader
* Work through ambiguity: propose structure, process, and scope rather than waiting for it to be handed to you.
* Partner closely with Product for visibility and alignment, while keeping engineering ownership and decision-making inside engineering.
* Provide regular updates, risks, and recommendations to senior (US-based) engineering leadership, including workforce and contract-to-hire decisions.
* Maintain meaningful overlap with US working hours for real-time collaboration with distributed stakeholders, architects, and product partners.
* Additional tasks associated with this position may be assigned in response to company initiatives and business needs.

More information about this role:

* This is a full-time and in-office position, reporting to our Chennai office 5 days a week.
* This individual may manage a team and will be reporting directly to our General Manager, Chennai Center of Excellence.
* The targeted compensation package for this role is between INR 55,00,000 LPA and INR 75,00,000 LPA. We may make further adjustments through an approval process if the targeted compensation range needs to be modified based on business needs and market trends.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or Engineering; platform or vendor certifications (e.g., ServiceNow, cloud platform, or API-management certifications) is strongly recommended.

**Experience:**

* Minimum 8+ years in software, systems, or integration engineering, including experience directly managing engineers (as an EM, or as a senior/staff engineer with clear, demonstrable people leadership experience) is required.
* Track record of building or scaling a team from the ground up ideally in a GCC, global captive, or new-site environment, not just growing an existing, well-defined team.
* Hands-on design and administration of API/integration platforms ServiceNow, MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, Azure Integration Services, or comparable including workflow, connector, and access design is required.
* Familiarity with the PSA (Professional Services Automation) ecosystem tools like ConnectWise, Autotask, Kaseya, or similar and how MSPs/partners consume vendor integrations through them.
* Integration design fundamentals: API contract design, data mapping and transformation, authentication patterns, and designing clean ownership boundaries and handoffs between systems and teams.
* AI-native, hands-on daily, practical use of AI tools in your own workflow (AI coding assistants, agentic dev tools, AI for documentation/testing), with the disposition to keep learning as the tooling changes, in line with our AI-DLC direction.
* ITSM/ticketing and collaboration tooling ServiceNow (or an equivalent ITSM tool) and the Atlassian suite (Jira, Confluence) for engineering workflow, tracking, and documentation.
* Experience operating in environments with formal change management, compliance requirements, and high security standards (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001) directly relevant given Sectigo's security/PKI domain.
* Genuine comfort with ambiguity able to create structure, process, and scope where none exists yet, without needing constant top-down direction.
* Ability to establish priorities and work independently with minimal supervision across time zones, with meaningful overlap with US business hours (e.g., available into the evening IST for standups, architecture reviews, and leadership syncs).
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across time zones, functions, and seniority levels.

**Ideal Candidate Profiles, Talents, and Desired Qualifications:**

* An established practice of using an AI assistant inside your engineering workflow change review, log analysis, documentation drafting.
* Relational databases and reporting/BI tools; directory services and access management (Active Directory or equivalent); general network and security concepts relevant to integration architecture.
* PKI and certificate management particularly relevant given Sectigo's core business.
* Prior experience setting up or leading a team inside a Global Capability Center (GCC) in India.
* Experience with contract-to-hire staffing models specifically in the India market.

Configure and optimize Zscaler Private Access deployments to deliver secure remote connectivity to internal applications while maintaining high performance and reliability for distributed teams
  
Deploy and maintain Palo Alto Prisma based security controls that provide advanced threat prevention and data protection across cloud services and remote endpoints
  
Administer Cisco Umbrella solutions to strengthen domain based filtering block malicious destinations and enhance protection against phishing and command and control activity

Collaborate with network and infrastructure teams to integrate security controls into existing architectures in a way that supports business operations and minimizes disruption for end users
  
Develop and maintain detailed architecture diagrams configuration baselines and technical documentation that support consistent operations and future scaling of cybersecurity solutions
  
Conduct incident analysis and problem resolution for security events related to proxy operation secure remote access and cloud edge security ensuring rapid containment and remediation
  
Drive continuous tuning of access policies authentication flows and content filtering rules to improve user experience while maintaining strong protection and regulatory compliance
  
Coordinate with compliance and risk stakeholders to ensure that security architectures meet internal standards and external obligations supporting trust from customers and partners
  
Support knowledge transfer and technical guidance for operational teams working in rotational shifts so that security platforms remain well managed and resilient at all times
  
  

Qualifications
  
Demonstrate strong experience in proxy operation and reverse proxy tools by configuring policies authentication methods and traffic inspection that align with modern enterprise security needs
  
Apply hands on expertise with Zscaler Private Access to design secure application access patterns optimize user connectivity and troubleshoot complex remote access scenarios

Employ strong analytical and problem solving abilities to investigate security issues interpret complex logs and recommend targeted improvements that strengthen the overall security posture
  
Communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical partners to explain design decisions security risks and remediation plans in a concise and accessible manner

We are looking for an experienced **BIM Coordinator** with 10\+ years of experience in the construction/engineering industry to lead and manage multidisciplinary BIM coordination activities. The candidate will be responsible for coordinating **Architectural, Civil, Structural and MEP models**, identifying and resolving clashes, reviewing construction drawings and ensuring accurate and coordinated BIM deliverables throughout the project lifecycle.

The ideal candidate should be capable of **independently leading BIM coordination**, coordinating with internal departments, consultants, contractors and project/site teams, and driving projects from design coordination through construction and as\-built stages.

* Lead and manage **multidisciplinary BIM coordination** between Architectural, Civil, Structural, MEP, QS and Project teams.
* Review and coordinate BIM models and construction drawings to ensure **design accuracy, constructability and coordination**.

* Manage and review BIM models up to **LOD 500**, including construction\-stage and as\-built requirements.
* Develop, implement and maintain **BIM Execution Plans, BIM standards, modelling procedures and QA/QC workflows**.

* Review shop drawings, coordinated drawings, model outputs and construction documentation for compliance with project requirements.
* Ensure proper model federation, version control, data management and coordination workflows.
* Support preparation and validation of **LOD 400/500 deliverables and as\-built BIM models**.
* Guide and mentor BIM Engineers/Modelers and ensure timely delivery of assigned BIM activities.
* Identify design conflicts at an early stage and proactively coordinate with relevant departments to minimize rework and site issues.
* Maintain effective communication between **design, engineering, BIM and construction teams** throughout the project lifecycle.

* Autodesk Revit

* Excellent understanding of **Architectural, Civil, Structural and MEP drawings** and construction methodology.
